claims.text: Ustekinumab (Crohn disease): a single weight-based IV induction infusion;
claims.quote: Crohn's Disease Initial Adult Intravenous Recommended Dose ( 2.3 ) : A single intravenous infusion using weight-based dosing:

claims.text: then 90 mg SC 8 weeks later and every 8 weeks after that.
claims.quote: A subcutaneous 90 mg dose 8 weeks after the initial intravenous dose, then every 8 weeks thereafter.

claims.text: Ustekinumab: evaluate for TB before starting;
claims.quote: Evaluate patients for tuberculosis infection prior to initiating treatment with STELARA.
Immunizations : Avoid use of live vaccines in patients during treatment with STELARA.

claims.text: if PRES is suspected, treat promptly and stop it.
claims.quote: Posterior Reversible Encephalopathy Syndrome (PRES) : If PRES is suspected, treat promptly, and discontinue STELARA.
